leadText: Gone Fishing!? (Japanese: ピカチュウのさかなつり!?, Pikachu's Fishing Trip!?), is the third bonus chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.
plainText:
Gone Fishing!? (Japanese: ピカチュウのさかなつり!?, Pikachu's Fishing Trip!?), is the third bonus chapter of the fifth volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Hazel and the others head down to the river to fish.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Hazel
Almond

Grandpa

==Character introductions==
None

==Important events==
 
==Trivia==
This four-page story originally ran in both Ciao and Shogakukan 6th Grader magazines.
